facts.text: Every Reed student must complete a yearlong senior thesis and defend it orally before professors across multiple disciplines to graduate.

sources.title: An invitation to apply for the position of president Reed College
sources.quote: All students must complete a senior thesis to graduate. A yearlong endeavor, often including original research and creative production, the thesis is followed by an oral defense before professors from several fields.

facts.text: All students must pass a junior qualifying exam testing their knowledge within their major before advancing to their senior thesis.

sources.title: An invitation to apply for the position of president Reed College
sources.quote: All students must pass a junior qualifying exam, a comprehensive test of their knowledge of the major fields within their chosen major.
